sloka: सुताभिलाषो मत्तस्ते मत्तमातङ्गगामिनि ।दारुणायां तु वेलायां यस्मात्त्वं मामुपस्थिता ।। ७.९.२१ ॥
transliteration: sutābhilāṣo mattaste mattamātaṅgagāmini ।dāruṇāyāṁ tu velāyāṁ yasmāttvaṁ māmupasthitā ।। 7.9.21 ॥

translations.english: O you who walk like an intoxicated elephant, since you have approached me at this dreadful time with a desire for a son from me.
